pattern: Elliott Wave (5-3 impulse/corrective wave counts, Fibonacci ratio targets)
reason: Non-falsifiable as commonly practiced: wave counts are re-labelled after the fact whenever price violates the prior count ("it must have been a wave (b), not wave 3"), and there is no single canonical rule-set -- Elliott/Prechter/Neely/Frost all differ on alternation, extension, and truncation rules, each with enough discretionary escape hatches that any price path can be fitted post hoc. A MECHANICAL, no-relabelling wave-counter (fixed pivot-detection threshold, fixed rule precedence, no re-labelling ever) is a materially different -- and much weaker -- object than what Elliott practitioners actually mean by "Elliott wave", so testing a rigid version and reporting it as a test of "Elliott wave analysis" would misrepresent what was tested. Declined per task instruction ("decline to test and say why"), not silently skipped.
resurrection_condition: A pre-registered, single, rigid pivot/wave-labelling algorithm with NO after-the-fact re-labelling allowed, proposed and frozen BEFORE seeing its backtest result.
